entities.summary: Elma Saiz Delgado is a Spanish politician who is serving as minister of Inclusion, Social Security and Migration since 2023. Before her incumbency, she was Regional Minister of Economy and Finance of Navarre between 2019 and 2023, and a member of the Pamplona City Council.
